title: Dispatch RFU 7: The Cloud Breaks as Workers Open the Culvert
summary: A figure reaches the courtyard while water finds the river.
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: The brick gate was lifted at dawn. Water passed through the old culvert into the river, while the cloud descended almost to the paving. A boy stepped out of the rain and took Mrs. Marr’s hand. He identified himself as Jonah and described going home along Old Weaver Street on the day of the flood.

He appears no older than the child in the photograph. Dr. Saye says he spent some part of the intervening years along a route Alderwick no longer possessed. He is under medical care and has not yet been asked to explain them.
